sources.note: The decTest corpus is not redistributed: dectestconv -provision downloads it into the gitignored local_dir and SHA-256-verifies every file against the download list. Committed data is limited to original constructions, case ids, content hashes and re-derived expectations with provenance.

directive-mapped.description: An extended-suite case in the finite value space under an adopted mode, run through the executor's directive and operation mapping and compared exactly (text and conditions).

non-finite.cites: finite-only value space: no NaN or Infinity values exist
non-finite.description: An operand or the expectation is NaN, sNaN or Infinity; no such value exists. Replacement error-path and condition-emission vectors are the committed fixtures.

encoding-operand.cites: IEEE 754 interchange encodings are not part of the library
encoding-operand.description: An operand or expectation uses decTest's # or width# encoding syntax.

clamp.cites: clamp: 1 contexts are not modelled; contexts never clamp exponents

clamped.cites: contexts never clamp exponents; results keep the ideal exponent
clamped.description: The expectation reports Clamped: GDA clamps an exponent into the guard lattice, this library keeps the ideal exponent.

signed-zero.description: The expectation is a negative zero, or max/min selects by the sign of a zero operand.

mode-05up.cites: rounding catalogue: seven modes plus Exact; 05up is not offered

subset.cites: X3.274 subset cases run only where their semantics coincide with the extended suite
subset.description: An X3.274 subset case with no coincident extended case (same operation, operands, directives other than extended, expectation and conditions), or one with Lost_digits: the subset semantics are not shown to coincide.

subset-coincident.cites: per-case coincidence with an adopted extended case
subset-coincident.description: An X3.274 subset case identical in operation, operands, directives other than extended, expectation and conditions to an adopted extended case: the semantics coincide, and it runs under the same mapping.

exceptional-refusal.cites: finite-only operations refuse with the condition GDA signals
exceptional-refusal.description: Finite operands whose GDA result is NaN or Infinity with only Division_by_zero, Conversion_syntax, Division_undefined or Invalid_operation: checked as a refusal carrying exactly those conditions (GDA with those traps enabled).

not-in-catalogue.cites: operation catalogue: the operation is out of scope
not-in-catalogue.description: The operation is not in the library's catalogue (logical, class, total ordering, next*, scaleb, logb, shift, rotate, samequantum, magnitude max/min, copysign, trim).

display-format.cites: Engineering is a display format, not GDA to-engineering-string

integral-exponent-zero.description: tointegral or tointegralx of an operand with a positive exponent: GDA returns it unchanged, this library publishes exponent 0 (or refuses when the coefficient exceeds p).

rescale-exponent-domain.cites: Quantize takes an int32 target exponent
rescale-exponent-domain.description: rescale whose right operand is not an integer in int32: GDA refuses it with Invalid_operation, and the library's signature cannot express it.

exponent-domain.description: An operand's exponent is outside int32.

format-suite.cites: decSingle/decDouble/decQuad format suites use interchange encodings and clamp: 1 contexts
format-suite.description: The ds, dd and dq suites.

driver-file.cites: the manifest classifies cases, not include drivers
driver-file.description: A file that only includes other suites (testall, decSingle, decDouble, decQuad) and holds no case.

zero-power-one.cites: 0^0 = 1, as in IEEE 754 pown and java.math.BigDecimal.pow
zero-power-one.description: GDA power gives NaN Invalid_operation for 0^0; this library returns 1. Re-derived with an independent lineage.

zero-power-cohort.cites: Pow of a zero base keeps the repeated-multiplication exponent n*e
zero-power-cohort.description: GDA power gives a zero base's positive power exponent 0; this library keeps the repeated-multiplication cohort n·e. Re-derived with an independent lineage.

integer-zero-divisor.cites: integer division with a zero divisor refuses with DivisionByZero
integer-zero-divisor.description: Nonzero finite remainder dividend with zero divisor refuses Division_by_zero.

integer-nearest-quotient.cites: RemNear checks the truncated quotient's fit
integer-nearest-quotient.description: RemNear checks truncated quotient fit; the nearest quotient may have p+1 digits.

integer-exact-remainder.cites: remainders are exact at the smaller operand exponent
integer-exact-remainder.description: Remainder remains exact at min operand exponent even when its coefficient exceeds precision.

exact-noninteger-power.cites: an exactly representable power is returned exactly at its shortest cohort
exact-noninteger-power.description: GDA marks every power with a noninteger exponent Inexact and Rounded and pads it to precision digits; the library returns a mathematically exact power exactly, at its shortest representable cohort, and reports Subnormal alone for an exact subnormal value.

finite-operand-range.cites: every finite operand is evaluated exactly; exponent guards apply to the result
finite-operand-range.description: The expectation refuses an operand whose exponent lies outside the context range with Invalid_operation; the library evaluates every finite operand exactly and applies the exponent guards to the result alone: an exact one, a saturated overflow or a zero below Etiny.
